intro p a b
unfold If_i
simp only [b_or, b_and, b_eq, b_not]
by_cases hp : p
· left
  constructor
  · exact hp
  · have hP : (fun x : set => (p ∧ x = a) ∨ (¬p ∧ x = b)) a := by
      left
      constructor
      · exact hp
      · rfl
    have hE := Eps_i_ax (fun x : set => (p ∧ x = a) ∨ (¬p ∧ x = b)) a hP
    rcases hE with hleft | hright
    · exact hleft.2
    · exfalso
      exact hright.1 hp
· right
  constructor
  · exact hp
  · have hP : (fun x : set => (p ∧ x = a) ∨ (¬p ∧ x = b)) b := by
      right
      constructor
      · exact hp
      · rfl
    have hE := Eps_i_ax (fun x : set => (p ∧ x = a) ∨ (¬p ∧ x = b)) b hP
    rcases hE with hleft | hright
    · exfalso
      exact hp hleft.1
    · exact hright.2

intros x P y hIn hP
unfold Sep
let cond : Prop := Megalodon.ex set (fun z => Megalodon.and (In z x) (P z))
let f : set → set := fun z => If_i (P z) z (Eps_i (fun w => Megalodon.and (In w x) (P w)))
change In y (If_i cond (Repl x f) Empty)
have hcond : cond := by
  dsimp [cond]
  simp only [b_ex, b_and]
  exact ⟨y, hIn, hP⟩
have hIf : If_i cond (Repl x f) Empty = Repl x f := by
  have h := If_i_1 cond (Repl x f) Empty hcond
  rw [b_eq] at h
  exact h
rw [hIf]
have hRepl : In y (Repl x f) ↔ ∃ z, In z x ∧ y = f z := by
  have h := ReplEq x f y
  simp only [b_iff, b_ex, b_and, b_eq] at h
  exact h
rw [hRepl]
have hfy : f y = y := by
  dsimp [f]
  have h := If_i_1 (P y) y (Eps_i (fun w => Megalodon.and (In w x) (P w))) hP
  rw [b_eq] at h
  exact h
exact ⟨y, hIn, hfy.symm⟩

intro A P x hInSep
try simp only [b_and] at *
unfold Sep at hInSep
simp only [b_ex, b_and] at hInSep
have hIf := If_i_correct (∃ z, In z A ∧ P z) (Repl A (fun z => If_i (P z) z (Eps_i (fun w => In w A ∧ P w)))) Empty
simp only [b_or, b_and, b_eq, b_not] at hIf
rcases hIf with hTrue | hFalse
· rcases hTrue with ⟨hcond, hEq⟩
  rw [hEq] at hInSep
  have hRepl := ReplE A (fun z => If_i (P z) z (Eps_i (fun w => In w A ∧ P w))) x hInSep
  simp only [b_ex, b_and, b_eq] at hRepl
  rcases hRepl with ⟨z, hzA, hxz⟩
  rw [hxz]
  have hIfz := If_i_correct (P z) z (Eps_i (fun w => In w A ∧ P w))
  simp only [b_or, b_and, b_eq, b_not] at hIfz
  rcases hIfz with hzTrue | hzFalse
  · rcases hzTrue with ⟨hPz, hEqz⟩
    rw [hEqz]
    exact ⟨hzA, hPz⟩
  · rcases hzFalse with ⟨hnPz, hEqe⟩
    rw [hEqe]
    rcases hcond with ⟨w, hwA, hwP⟩
    have hEps := Eps_i_ax (fun w => In w A ∧ P w) w ⟨hwA, hwP⟩
    exact hEps
· rcases hFalse with ⟨hnotcond, hEqEmpty⟩
  rw [hEqEmpty] at hInSep
  have hEmptyAx := EmptyAx
  simp only [b_not, b_ex] at hEmptyAx
  exfalso
  exact hEmptyAx ⟨x, hInSep⟩
